description: Use first when someone asks a question in plain words and you do not know which Tickerz index answers it, for example "how many Americans feel lonely", "is NYC eviction rising", "how much do New Yorkers bet on sports" or "how many asteroids passed close to Earth". Returns the best matching indexes, best first, each with its ticker, name, what it counts, family, a 0 to 1 score, its page and its API address. Then call get_index with the ticker for the numbers. An empty list means no Tickerz index measures it: name_a_number asks for one. Same as GET /api/indices/search?q=. Read only. Tickerz keeps no record of who asked. When the Jev ranking is on, the question text is sent to TypeSafe to rank the indexes, and the answer is kept for a day under that text.

limit.description: How many indexes to return, 1 to 10, default 5
